principal_question: On a balanced prospective synthetic benchmark of ambiguous spacecraft information sets, what fraction of individually one-step-feasible cases receive an on-time, independently recheckable common-prefix or HCW first-command-obstruction certificate?
primary_endpoint: on_time_decisive_valid among cases where every hidden hypothesis has a validated one-second HCW prefix under the fixed qualification action library

primary_inference.method: Hoeffding interval for independent bounded, not necessarily identically distributed Bernoulli trials

pilot_may_inform: expected local wall time and disk use
whether the predeclared generator is capable of producing eligible cases
reserve_rule: If minimum pilot eligibility fraction is at least 0.90 use 288 protected reserve seeds per stratum; if 0.60 to below 0.90 use 384; below 0.60 blocks freezing and returns to development.
secondary_endpoints: pairwise-only false-safe shortcut among 3+ hypothesis cases
native Task05 predictive/barrier protection status under disclosed hull adapter
decision wall time and one-second budget misses
multiplicity: One confirmatory primary endpoint. Secondary endpoints are descriptive and do not support multiplicity-unadjusted confirmatory claims.
integrity_gate: Any definite candidate certificate that fails its independent stored-certificate recheck is reported and blocks the validity claim; unknown or failed computation never becomes safe.
